transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I’m here because I feel like I’m always running hot. Like I can’t shut the motor off. And lately it’s been causing problems at the firehouse.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or having trouble sitting still?
Yeah. I mean… if I’m sitting in a meeting, my leg’s usually bouncing. I’ll click a pen, shift around, mess with whatever’s on the table. Half the time I don’t even realize I’m doing it.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?

Yeah… I do. Mostly at work. Like when the guys are talking through a plan, I’ll jump in because I already think I know the answer. Then I realize I cut somebody off or kind of messed up the flow. It’s… not great.
Do you often have difficulty paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

Yeah… that happens. I’ll finish an incident report thinking it’s fine, and then the captain catches stuff — wrong unit number, a missing time stamp, some box I skipped that actually matters for the safety review. Stuff like that.
Do you ever find yourself so focused on something that you tune out everything else around you?
I’m not sure. I mean… maybe sometimes, but I don’t really notice that one as much. Usually I’m more aware when I can’t stay on something.
Have you always felt this way, even when you were a kid?

Yeah… from what my mom says, it was there pretty early. Grade school kind of stuff — out of my seat, blurting answers, losing homework. I’d get notes sent home, even though I guess I could do the work.
Do you often have strong mood swings?
I don’t know… not really strong swings, I guess. I can get irritated, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed big mood changes like that.
Do you experience these symptoms at home or when you're not at work, like when you're with friends or family?

Yeah… it’s not just work. At home too. Like on days off, if we’re supposed to just sit and do something quiet with the family, I don’t last long. I’ll start talking, or I’m up moving around, checking something in the garage… tools or whatever. I just don’t stay sitting very well.
Do you often feel overly angry or frustrated for no clear reason?
Not really for no reason, no. I mean, I get frustrated sometimes, but there’s usually something setting it off. I wouldn’t call it out of nowhere.
Do you feel like your symptoms are causing problems in your relationships with family or friends?
I’m not really sure. I mean… maybe sometimes it annoys people, but I don’t know if I’d say it’s causing big relationship problems. I haven’t really thought about it that way.
Have you experienced these symptoms consistently throughout your childhood and into adulthood?

Yeah… I think so. My mom’s said I was like this even back in grade school. Getting up out of my seat, blurting stuff out, losing homework… notes getting sent home. She always says I was smart enough to do it, I just… didn’t keep it together.
Have you ever been in a situation where your behavior or symptoms got you into trouble or caused significant problems at work or in your personal relationships?

Yeah… at work, mostly. It’s gotten to the point where the guys don’t really trust me with details like they used to. I got pulled into a performance and safety meeting over it, which was… not great.

I was hoping to move into more of a leadership role, but now it feels like that’s slipping away because the crew can’t count on me to keep track of things consistently.
Do you think your difficulty with paying attention or your restlessness and fidgeting causes more problems for you?

Probably the restlessness… the always being keyed up. I feel like I’m running hot most of the time, like I can’t really shut the motor off. That’s more of what’s been getting me into trouble at the firehouse lately.
Do you think you have more trouble with paying attention or with controlling your impulses and activity level?
More the impulse and activity thing, I guess. I’m just… always running hot, like I can’t shut the motor off. That’s the part that’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse lately.
Do you think your difficulty with paying attention or your impulsivity and hyperactivity causes more problems for you in your daily life?
Yeah… more the hyperactive side, I think. I just feel like I’m always running hot, like I can’t shut the motor off. That’s what’s been causing problems at the firehouse lately.
Have you experienced any periods in your life where these symptoms seemed to disappear or significantly decrease?

Not really… not in the last year or so. It’s been a real problem for, I don’t know, about a year and five months—since the longer rotating shifts started, and they added all the extra documentation and drone stuff. Before that it was there, but not like this.
Do you think your problems with paying attention or your problems with restlessness and impulsivity cause you more trouble overall?

Probably the restlessness and impulse side. I mean… paying attention is hard too, but the bigger problem is I’m always keyed up, like I can’t shut the motor off. That’s what’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Do you think your problems with paying attention or your problems with restlessness and impulsivity are about equally troublesome for you?
Not really equally, no. It’s more the restlessness… feeling like I’m always running hot and can’t shut it off. That’s the part that’s been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Do you often find yourself easily distracted by things around you?

Yeah… pretty often. It doesn’t take much. A radio chirp, someone walking by the bay, even just some thought about a call from yesterday, and I’m off what I was doing. Then it takes me a while to get back to it.
Do you often forget things you were supposed to do?

Yeah. More than I’d like. I’ll mean to do something and then it just… doesn’t happen. Like signing off on training modules, calling somebody back, paying a bill before it gets a fee, or bringing the right paperwork in for shift. Stuff like that.
